## Relationships

The mail addon is the **foundational messaging and collaboration platform**:

```
mail (root)
├── models/
│   ├── discuss/ — Real-time chat, channels, RTC sessions, guests
│   ├── mail_*.py — Email, templates, aliases, activities, tracking
│   ├── ir_*.py — Infrastructure extensions (HTTP, mail server, models, attachments)
│   ├── res_*.py — User/company mail preferences and settings
│   ├── fetchmail.py — Inbound email gateway
│   └── [mixins] — mail_thread, mail_alias, mail_render, activity_mixin
├── controllers/
│   ├── discuss/ — Channel, messaging, RTC, voice, settings, binary (file) endpoints
│   ├── mail.py — Main mail HTTP handler
│   ├── thread.py — Document chatter endpoints
│   ├── mailbox.py — User mailbox and message list
│   ├── attachment.py — File upload/download
│   ├── guest.py — Guest user session management
│   ├── message_reaction.py — Emoji reaction endpoints
│   ├── link_preview.py — Link metadata fetching
│   ├── google_translate.py — Translation service integration
│   └── [webclient] — Settings, manifest, WebSocket management
├── wizard/ — Modal dialogs (compose, activity schedule, blacklist, template preview)
├── report/ — Mail and activity analytics
└── static/src/ — Extensive OWL frontend (discuss UI, mail UI, common components)
```

**Core Interaction Patterns:**
- **Mail Gateway**: Inbound email via alias routing → mail.message creation
- **Chatter**: mail.thread mixin on any model → document discussion threads
- **Activities**: Assigned tasks with scheduling and reminders
- **Discuss**: Real-time channels via bus.bus longpolling and WebSocket
- **Presence**: User online/offline state via bus and longpolling
- **Notifications**: Per-user notification preferences with sound/desktop integration

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Foundational Component**: Mail is the backbone of Odoo collaboration. Every document model with chatter and every user depends on this addon. Do NOT synthesize as a feature component; it is infrastructure.
- **High Branching Factor**: Extends nearly every core Odoo model (ir.*, res.*). Acts as a cross-cutting concern; synthesize carefully to avoid circular component dependencies.
- **Real-Time Subsystem**: Discuss channels and presence tracking depend on the bus addon. Complex frontend architecture (OWL components, WebRTC, longpolling). Requires separate detailed synthesis for frontend vs backend.
- **Email Gateway**: Supports both inbound (POP3/IMAP via fetchmail) and outbound (SMTP via ir.mail_server). Integration point with external email infrastructure.
- **Multi-Tenant Aware**: All models respect company_id and user isolation; safe for multi-company deployments.
- **Heavy Customization Surface**: Widely extended by other addons (mail_bot, mass_mailing, crm_mail_plugin, etc.). Changes here ripple across the system.
